messages:
maria: heads-up: encountered a parity bug in samplekit when using jsonMode + function/tool calling on Node. retry path ends up stringifying fn call args twice.

sam: yikes. can you share a tiny repro?

maria: repro: Node SDK v2.3.1, jsonMode: { strict: true }, tool returns { result: { id: 42, value: 'ok' } }. Induce a transient auth error to force retry. final payload arriving at validator has function_call.arguments as a string containing another JSON string.

maria: log snippet:
```
{ function_call: { name: "parse_payload", arguments: "{\"result\":\"{\\\"id\\\":42,\\\"value\\\":\"ok\\\"}\"}" } }
```

sam: looks like we JSON.stringify'ed the arguments twice on the retry codepath. Does that cause schema errors?

maria: yep. our schema-validation eval expects an object but receives a JSON string, so tests blow up. Interesting thing: Python sampleapp doesn't hit this, so seems Node retry wrapper is the culprit.

devex-bot: created DEVEX-1427: "node sdk retry path re-stringifies fncall/tool args" (assignee: sam)

jordan: probable root cause: we cache or log bodies as strings and then when reconstructing request for retry we call JSON.stringify on the whole body again. Also note we changed how rawBody is surfaced in the HTTP layer last sprint.

lee: mitigation for affected customers: set `jsonMode: { rawToolOutput: true }` or run `parseToolOutput(res)` immediately after the response and before schema validation. Will add this to the samplekit onboarding notes.

sam: i'll make a minimal repro and open a PR in sdk-core to avoid re-stringifying `function_call.arguments` during retry. Plan: preserve Buffer/string for body, only re-serialize top-level when necessary. Add unit + integration tests in samplekit.

maria: i'll add a failing integration test to catch regressions and update the onboarding checklist to mention the retry caveat.

lee: lower-risk hotfix: on the validation path, if `typeof function_call.arguments === 'string'` and jsonMode.strict, attempt a JSON.parse and emit a telemetry event if parse fails so teams can opt into more strict behavior.

sam: agree. will add an opt-in telemetry flag and a clear changelog note so we don't silently mask encoding issues.

jordan: note to production teams: if you see sudden schema regressions after deploys, check for retry double-serialization first (especially if you use jsonMode strict + fncall).

maria: thanks all. i'll post updates in the samplekit repo and the SDK quirks docs once PR lands. :thumbsup:
